questions.q: In object-oriented programming, which feature allows an object to take multiple forms based on its context?
questions.e: Polymorphism lets one operation behave differently depending on the object.

questions.q: In object-oriented programming, which principle suggests that details of a class should not be visible to the outside world?
questions.e: Encapsulation hides the internal details of a class behind public methods.

questions.q: In object-oriented programming, what does "polymorphism" mean?
questions.e: Polymorphism means one interface with different behaviours, for example through overloading and overriding.

questions.q: What is the output of the following Python code? print(2 ** 3 ** 2)
questions.e: The ** operator is evaluated right to left: 3 ** 2 = 9, then 2 ** 9 = 512.

In Java, what does the finally block do?
o: Executes code regardless of whether an exception is thrown
questions.e: The finally block runs whether or not an exception happens.

questions.q: In web development, what does the term "responsive design" refer to?
o: Designing websites that respond to user input
Designing websites that adapt to different screen sizes and devices
questions.e: Responsive design makes a page adapt to different screen sizes.

questions.q: What is the purpose of the command "npm" in JavaScript development?
o: Node Package Manager: manages JavaScript libraries and packages
Navigate Page Middleware: manages web page navigation
New Project Module: creates a new JavaScript project
Network Protocol Monitor: monitors network traffic
questions.e: npm is the Node Package Manager, for JavaScript libraries and packages.

questions.q: In the context of web development, what does the term "CSS" stand for?
questions.e: CSS stands for Cascading Style Sheets.

questions.q: Which programming language is often used for building cross-platform mobile applications?
questions.e: React Native builds apps for several mobile platforms from one codebase.

questions.q: In the context of web development, what is a "cookie"?
o: A small piece of data stored on a user's device
questions.e: A cookie is a small piece of data a website stores on the user's device.

questions.q: Which programming language is often used for scripting in web development?
Which programming paradigm is associated with object-oriented programming (OOP)?
questions.e: Object-oriented programming is its own paradigm.

questions.q: What is the purpose of a compiler?
o: Convert source code into machine code
questions.e: A compiler converts source code into machine code.

questions.q: Which type of programming language is JavaScript?
questions.e: JavaScript is normally run by an interpreter in the browser.

questions.q: Who is the father of the C programming language?
questions.e: Dennis Ritchie created C at Bell Labs in the early 1970s.

questions.q: What do you call the translator which takes assembly language program as input & produce machine language code as output?
questions.e: An assembler translates assembly language into machine code.
